summary.text: Pam Marsh is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 5 in southern Jackson County who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the House Committee on Housing and Homelessness.

paragraphs.text: On her legislative website, Pam Marsh says she is serving a fifth term and that her district runs from the Applegate to the Greensprings and includes Ashland, Talent, Phoenix, southwest Medford, Jacksonville and Ruch.
She is vice chair of the House Committee on Higher Education and a member of the committees on Climate, Energy and Environment; Agriculture, Land Use, Natural Resources, and Water; and Revenue.

Marsh lists long-term financial sustainability of higher education, affordable housing, climate resilience and clean energy, wildfire mitigation and response, and broadband as policy areas she is focusing on for the 2027 session.
